svg.title: The crew: Coco, Nemo, Tofu
svg.desc: Coco: Shadow rogue; STEALTH 10/10, AGILITY 9/10, CHAOS 7/10 · Nemo: Chaos berserker; ENERGY 10/10, CHAOS 10/10, STEALTH 2/10 · Tofu: Cozy healer; HEALING 10/10, CHARM 9/10, NAP POWER 10/10
